pr_title: cockroach-sql: reduce the size of the SQL-only executable
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/67738)

issue_context.title: cli/sql: trim down the deps of the SQL shell to achieve a binary smaller than 10MiB
issue_context.body:
PR  #67469 is introducing a standalone `cockroach-sql` which only contains the SQL shell via the new packages `clisqlshell` and related.

These are *intended* to only contain the minimum client code sufficient to run a shell, however unfortunately **the generated binary is still 100-200MB large**.

We want to trim down this size by breaking the dependencies on the crdb server code.

Here are some discrete tasks to achieve this:

- [x] #67482
  - [x] stop using `tree.ParseDInterval` to interpret the results of `SHOW LAST QUERY STATISTICS`. Instead, use a lightweight parser local to the SQL shell.
  - [x] stop using `tree.Name` to quote the database name. Use the underlying function from the `lex` package directly (which is lightweight)
  - [x] stop using `roachpb.NodeID` and use int32 instead.
  - [x] #67481
- [x] #67490
  - [x] #67491
  - [x] break the dependency on `sessiondatapb` by lifting `BytesEncodeEscape` into a lightweight dependency package and use that
  - [x] break the dependency on `lex` by lifting `EncodeByteArrayToRawBytes` into `lexbase` or another lightweight dep package
- [x] trim down `clisqlshell`
  - [x] break up one dependency on the `parser` package  by fixing #64710 
  - [x] break up the remaining dependencies on the `parser` package:
    - [ ] extract help texts into separate package
    - [ ] move `parser.LastLexicalToken` to  `lexbase` package
  - [x] break up the dependency on `sql` by moving the txn constants to a sub-package

- [x] trim down the binary by reducing the size of the `log` package
  - [x]  make the dependency on the `util/tracing` package optional in `log` using dependency injection, and don't use it in the CLI code

cc @kernfeld-cockroach 
cc @cockroachdb/sql-experience
